title: Texas Tech coach Joey McGuire: We'll definitely look at adding a player cut by an NFL team

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Texas Tech coach Joey McGuire: We'll definitely look at adding a player cut by an NFL team
sources.description: "I know this: I get to keep my job if I win, and so I'm gonna constantly look at how we can be better as a team, and be better roster-wise," McGuire said.
